title: HtmlTextarea
responsibility: Renders the native textarea element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlTextarea.attributes
inputs.description: Native textarea attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlTextarea.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native textarea element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlTextarea
outputs.description: The actual native textarea element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
